decisions.reason: The source confirms prices for the Basic package, while this candidate governs transparent pricing for individual services. The package matrix does not necessarily change any current candidate attribute.
The deferred calculator uses square-footage tiers and bundle rules, but the source only confirms the Basic package's displayed pricing matrix and does not direct the calculator to use these amounts.
Confirming Basic package prices does not change the one-time pricing model or the visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The pricing matrix does not change the requirement for a navigation entry leading to detailed pricing information.
The Basic package pricing confirmation has no necessary effect on the homepage's visual direction, image emphasis, or blue overlay.
The confirmed package prices are unrelated to the homepage gallery's animation behavior.
The package pricing matrix does not change gallery scrolling, tab organization, or secondary gallery content.
The confirmed Basic package prices do not affect whether gallery hover animations are enabled.
The pricing decision does not alter the sitewide requirement for highly visual, image-focused design.
The Basic package pricing matrix does not change the requirement to associate each listed service with a relevant image.
